title: N-Substitution effects on the conformations of iminosugar analogues of 1-deoxy-L-idose and 1-deoxy-L-iduronic acid
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,9412-9420
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09936F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lorenzo Taglietti, Eva Palomba, Heiko Lange, Luca Zoia, Maria Assunta Chiacchio, Laura Legnani, Barbara La Ferla
We herein report the synthesis and complete conformational analysis of a focused library of iminosugar analogues of L-idose and L-iduronic acid designed to probe the impact of N-substitution on ring dynamics.
